name: Kayes

queries.query: Kayes Mali cadastral map parcel cadastre official registry
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Mali DGDC site, its regional/subregional services page with DRDC/KAYES, the public NINACAD viewer, and the official DGDC cadastre page. No Kayes parcel geometry was established by the public routes inspected.

queries.query: Kayes Mali cadastre parcelles foncières carte site officiel
queries.result: La recherche de première partie a confirmé la Direction générale des Domaines et du Cadastre, la DRDC de Kayes et l'organisation communale du cadastre; aucun service public anonyme exposant une géométrie parcellaire de Kayes n'a été vérifié.

registryEvidence.custodian: Direction générale des Domaines et du Cadastre du Mali, Direction régionale des Domaines et du Cadastre de Kayes (DRDC/KAYES)
registryEvidence.basis: The official DGDC regional/subregional services page explicitly lists DRDC/KAYES with a telephone number. This evidences a regional cadastral custodian, not an open parcel dataset.

officialSources.observation: Current public NINACAD viewer shell; its JavaScript configuration points to the public API and GeoServer parcel service.
officialSources.scope: Public national NINACAD viewer; the current public commune response did not contain Kayes.

officialSources.observation: WFS capabilities expose layer sifMali:parcelle, EPSG:4326, and advertised WGS84 extent longitude -9.461653050247671 to -6.053873462910213.
officialSources.scope: Advertised service extent does not reach Kayes longitude -11.4398841889849; this is a service-extent limit, not evidence of citywide absence.

officialSources.observation: Official DGDC page describes communal, local, regional and national cadastral organization and unique parcel identification (NINACAD).
officialSources.scope: National cadastral policy and procedure; not an anonymous Kayes geometry endpoint.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: National NINACAD viewer and DGDC cadastral system; regional custodian at Kayes is listed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The inspected public parcel layer advertises an extent east of Kayes and the viewer exposes no Kayes commune/section entry; no Kayes geometry was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A regional cadastral custodian is verified, but no safe anonymous Kayes parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified from the current public viewer/API. Exact-point/bounded-box absence and service extent were not generalized to citywide cadastral absence.
